MINUTES
  TRAFFIC AND SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MARCH 3, 2020

1.  CHAIR ZERUNYAN called the meeting to order at 6:00 pm.

2.  ROLL CALL

  COMMITTEE MEMBERS PRESENT:  Zerunyan, Boothe, Combs, Martin, Munday,
  Scott, Vanden Bos, Van Ingen Pope

  COMMITTEE MEMBERS ABSENT:  Lum, Bain

  STAFF PRESENT:  David Wahba, Director of Community Development & Public Works
  Joanne Itagaki, Traffic Engineering Deputy
  Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant

3.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

A.  TRAFFIC AND SAFETY COMMITTEE DRAFT MINUTES, MEETING OF NOVEMBER
  13, 2019

COMMITTEE MEMBER MARTIN made a motion, seconded by COMMITTEE MEMBER
MUNDAY to,

  APPROVE THE TRAFFIC AND SAFETY COMMITTEE MEETING MINUTES OF
  NOVEMBER 13, 2019.

There being no objection, CHAIR ZERUNYAN so ordered.

4.  AUDIENCE ITEMS WRITTEN/ORAL COMMUNICATIONS NOT ON AGENDA

COMMITTEE MEMBER BOOTHE stated that at Silver Spur Road and Palos Verdes Drive North
there is a stop sign that is not well illuminated. Director Wahba stated that there is a light on the
north side of the street, however, it is not as bright as LED lights on Crenshaw Blvd. and
Hawthorne Blvd. New stop signs have been ordered. Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated
that the stop signs will be larger and have higher reflectivity. Director Wahba stated that he has
requested that the trees will be cut back to provide more visibility of the stop signs from a greater
distance.

5.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

A.  CRENSHAW BOULEVARD AT PALOS VERDES DRIVE NORTH AND AT CHADWICK
  LANE – CONCERNS OF ACADEMY HILLS HOME ASSOCIATION

Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated that this is a request by Katia Gomez, President of the
Academy Hill Homes Association. The request is for a “No Right Turn on Red” sign for southbound
traffic on Crenshaw Blvd. at Palos Verdes Drive North. The second request is to add a right turn
only lane on Crenshaw Blvd. at Chadwick Lane.

Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki provided information on traffic counts at these sites and
provided traffic collision history.

Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated that after her observations at Crenshaw Boulevard and
Palos Verdes Drive North, she concluded that a “No Right Turn on Red” sign will cause a
significant delay in traffic movement. The traffic collision history demonstrated that motorists make
turns safely at this intersection.

Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated that there are significant right turns at Crenshaw
Boulevard to Chadwick Lane and, based on preliminary roadway measurements, a “right turn
only” lane can be accommodated at this location.

Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated that the following is recommended:

  1. Maintain the existing traffic controls at Crenshaw Boulevard/Palos Verdes Drive North.

Traffic and Safety Committee Meeting  1
Minutes, March 3, 2020
   2. Install a right turn only lane for southbound Crenshaw Boulevard at Chadwick Lane with
  appropriate signage.

In response to a question by CHAIR ZERUNYAN, Director Wahba stated that the section of
Crenshaw Blvd. at Chadwick Lane is under the city’s jurisdiction. Traffic Engineering Deputy
Itagaki added that staff will confirm this.

In response to a question by Katia Gomez, Director Wahba stated that the construction at
Crenshaw Blvd. and Palos Verdes Drive North will be completed by June.

David Bernstein, Resident, suggested a “Yield to U-Turn Traffic” sign. Traffic Engineering Deputy
Itagaki stated that she is concerned with mixed messages for drivers but will look into this.

The Traffic and Safety Committee’s consensus was to maintain the existing traffic controls at
Crenshaw Boulevard and Palos Verdes Drive North.

COMMITTEE MEMBER VANDEN BOS expressed his concern with the quick merge from
Crenshaw Boulevard between Palos Verdes Drive North and Chadwick Lane. Deputy Engineering
Deputy Itagaki suggested adding a “Thru Traffic Merge Left” with an arrow just after the
intersection.

The Traffic and Safety Committee’s consensus was to add a right turn only lane for southbound
Crenshaw Boulevard at Chadwick Lane with appropriate signage assuming there is enough
dimension and confirmation on jurisdiction.

COMMITTEE MEMBER SCOTT made a motion, seconded by COMMITTEE MEMBER MARTIN
to,
  RECOMMEND TO THE CITY COUNCIL TO ADD A RIGHT TURN ONLY LANE FOR
  SOUTHBOUND CRENSHAW BOULEVARD AT CHADWICK LANE WITH
  APPROPRIATE SIGNAGE.

There being no objection, CHAIR ZERUNYAN so ordered.

6.  DIRECTOR ITEMS

NONE

7.  COMMITTEE ITEMS/FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

A.  FUTURE MEETING DATES

Traffic Engineering Deputy Itagaki stated that the Traffic and Safety Committee meeting in
November is scheduled on the same day as the Presidential Election. Director Wahba stated that
staff will provide the Committee with options for a new meeting date.

COMMITTEE MEMBER BOOTHE expressed her concern with drivers making a U-turn out of
Rolling Hills Methodist Church on Crenshaw Blvd. Deputy Bouse stated that it is a legal U-turn.

COMMITTEE MEMBER MARTIN asked for a report on the CalWater project for the next Traffic
and Safety Committee meeting.

8.  ADJOURNMENT

CHAIR ZERUNYAN adjourned the meeting at 6:36 pm. The next Traffic and Safety Committee
meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 5, 2020 at 6:00 pm.

Respectfully submitted,  Approved by,

___________________________________  _____________________________
Carol Corea, Administrative Assistant  Frank Zerunyan, Chair
